title: sheetpane rules file
description: Rules a host ships for <sheetpane-excel>: per sheet ("*" for every sheet), by column title and by cell or range. Failures become errors in <sheetpane-errors>. SR-GRID decision 22d.

version.description: The document's version; this grid reads 1.

sheets.description: Keyed by sheet name; "*" applies to every sheet, and a named sheet's rule for the same title wins.

headerRow.description: The row holding the column titles (1-based).

columns.description: Rules by column title, matched trimmed and case-insensitive.

cells.description: Rules by A1 cell or range, e.g. "B1" or "H3:H40".

bound.description: A number, or for type "date" an ISO date or a serial.

pattern.description: A regular expression tested against the cell's text (not over 10,000 characters).

unique.description: No other row of the column holds it (column rules).

note.description: For whoever maintains the rules; never shown as the message.
